scope: How often Russian text spells each token of 2 to 5 letters in capitals, all Latin or all Cyrillic: web_cyrillic and web_latin in the Leipzig word lists of Russian news, web and Wikipedia text, which keep a word's case; technical_cyrillic and technical_latin among the tokens of the ru.stackoverflow training messages, edge signs stripped, every developer-chat question left out. A count under 5 is cut: below it a spelling is chance (`ВШМ` 2, `DIV` 4). iso4217: the alphabetic codes of ISO 4217 list one. lexicon_capitals: the forms the Russian lexicon of the intent model writes in capitals. The upper-case head reads each section apart (ks-train capitals).
